The '''Aquilaris system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sanbra sector/Legends|Sanbra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquilaris]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the [[Aquilaris Minor system/Legends|Aquilaris Minor system]] was invented to account for mapping discrepancies between [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] and previous sources.<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref>
